Addresses are placed in 300 / 500 / 1000 m bands from Gwanghwamun Gate by geocoding each lot address with VWorld at build time; no coordinates are stored (VWorld results may not be stored).
Records are past towing reports (DCLR_DT = report date), not current obstacles.
Districts changed how they log towing over the years; compare years inside one district only.

Some report kinds are the reporter's own free text; those are counted as 기타(신고자 자유 기재).
Both stations are Seoul Metro lines in OA-15994: Gyeongbokgung (Line 3) and Gwanghwamun (Line 5).
'none listed' means the feed has no elevator row for that exit, not that the exit has no lift.
You have about 131 cm to get past, so you should fit through with room to spare.
